title: Minecraft, but block are liquid
description: This mod turn blocks into liquid
body:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/mpBKOHZUld4" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>
This mod adds liquid block
you need to touch the liquid to gain they ability
Press V to open the shop menu
Here are the items and their abilities
1.bucket container: you can collect dirt, sand, gravel, oak log, iron, slime, soul sand, anvil, end stone.

2.dirt bucket: any entity that hurt you has 40 chance to sink down
a.dirt item: shot dirt that slow entity

3.sand bucket: you become almost immortal and weak as a fish
a.sand item: trapped entity inside sand

4.gravel bucket: disable your gravity
a.gravel item: hit an entity and they will start to levitate

5.oak log bucket: shift on grass block to fill up hunger
a.oak log item: shit and right click on a tree to collect it and right click the tree to get random tree loot with a chance of enchanted apple and golden apple

6.iron bucket: you get strength and slowness
a.iron item: right click summon iron golem

7.slime bucket: double jump to jump higher
a.slime: shoot slime that poison entity's

8.soul sand bucket: shift to hurt any entity in 10 block radius
a.soul sand sword: deals a huge amount of damage and a chance to insta-kill

9.anvil bucket: huge amount of slowness and strength and disable fall damage
a.anvil item: right click to smash the ground

10.end bucket: teleport randomly when hurt
a.end item: right to summon ender eye entity's
